graph.title: LEGO BrickHeadz 41485 Finn
notes: Pieces are numbered b1..b91 in build order; every one of the 91 listed pieces appears exactly once.
Stud-to-stud mapping on the body, head ring, face and base is read from small isometric pictures. Exact port numbers are best guesses. Which pieces touch is much more reliable than which stud pairs.

The model is built in the orientation shown: the white 4x4 plate (b1) is the underside of the body, and the legs (steps 21-23) attach to its anti-studs. In the plate and brick port naming, 'stud.r.c' / 'anti.r.c' means row r, column c as seen from the build view.

In step 2 I assumed the 1x1 clip plate (b5) clips round plate b6, and the other round plates stack on it (b9 and b7 on b6, b8 on b7). The pictured barrel layout is ambiguous. The white round plate b82 from step 24 is assumed to sit on the black round plate b86 in the muzzle.
The gun (b85) is assumed to be held by the clip tile b83, which sits on a stud of the clip-on-side plate b30 (the left arm).

The head is a ring of 6 bricks per layer: b32-b37 (layer 1) and b42-b47 (layer 2). The face uses side studs on the front pair b36/b37 and b46/b47. The left side is b32/b42 and the right side is b33/b43. The back is b34/b35 and b44/b45.

The step 12-13 face pieces are placed as brown 2x3 plates b49/b50 on the lower 3 rows and black 92593 b51 on the top row. The brown tile 2x4 b53 and brown 92593 b54 go over the 2x3 studs. The brown 1x4 tile b52 is assumed to sit on the 2 studs of b51. The eyes b55/b56 are on b54.

Hair plates are assigned as b57 on the left side and b66 on the right side. Their tiles, plates and slopes sit on the studs of those side plates. b62/b63 cover the back face. b64 with tile b65 (step 18) is assumed to stack on the back plates because its position is unclear in the pictures.
The base (step 25) positions of b87/b88/b89/b90 and the leg soles b80/b81 on the 6x6 plate are approximate.
No sub-assembly is built more than once as a unit, so repeats is empty.
